## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

# Isoform usage

## Loading libraries

```{r}
library(DEXSeq)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Turning categorical ariables into factors in metadata

```{r}
lihcMetaFull[c("sample", "condition", "gender")] <-
lapply(lihcMetaFull[c("sample", "condition", "gender")], factor)
```

"sample", "condition", "gender" : replace them with the categorical variables in our dataset

## Differential Isoform usage on Data Subset

```{r}
dxdSubset <- DEXSeqDataSet(
countData = lichIsoCountSubset,
sampleData = lihcMetaFull,
design= ~ sample + exon + condition:exon + gender:exon,
featureID = txInfoSubset$transcript_id,
groupID = txInfoSubset$gene_id
)
```

lichIsoCountSubset: the raw data counts for genes (not isoforms)

lihcMetaFull: the metadata after turning the categorical variables into factors

## Testing for differential isoform usage

### Estimating size-factors

```{r}
dxdSubset <- estimateSizeFactors(dxdSubset)
```

### Estimating dispersion

```{r}
dxdSubset <- estimateDispersions(dxdSubset)
```

### Testing

```{r}
dxdSubset <- testForDEU(
dxdSubset,
fullModel = ~ sample + exon + condition:exon + gender:exon,
reducedModel = ~ sample + exon + gender:exon
)
```

### Exon Fold Changes

```{r}
dxdSubset <- estimateExonFoldChanges(dxdSubset, fitExpToVar = "condition")
```

## Getting the results of DEXSeq

```{r}
dxdResult <- DEXSeqResults(dxdSubset)
```

### Getting significant results

Retrieving the isoforms with an adjusted p-value of 0.05

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05

sig_iso <- dxdResult[!is.na(dxdResult$padj) & dxdResult$padj < alpha, ]
n_sig_isoforms <- nrow(sig_iso)
n_sig_isoforms
```

### Number of significant genes

```{r}
n_sig_genes <- length(unique(sig_iso$groupID))
n_sig_genes
```

### Top 5 most significant genes

```{r}
sig_iso <- as.data.frame(sig_iso)
dexseq_df <- sig_iso[order(sig_iso$padj), ]
top5_genes <- dexseq_df$groupID[!is.na(dex_seq$padj)][1:5]
```
